newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Wireless services firms started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Wireless services firms started.

text.p: Robertson, Stephens & Company said research analyst Steven Yanis initiated coverage on 12 wireless services companies.
-- said the following stocks were started with buy ratings: AirTouch Communications Inc, Omnipoint Corp, Western Wireless Corp and CommNet Cellular Inc .
-- said started four companies as long-term attractive: 360 Communications Co, Nextel Communications Inc, Vanguard Cellular Systems Inc and Telephone and Data Systems Inc.
-- said interest in the group has increased, pushing a few stocks "meaningfully higher" following recent leveraged buyouts.

-- said interest also increased on speculation of possible foreign investment in PCS companies, and the FCC's indication that it may permit foreign entities to own up to 100 percent of wireless licenses.
-- said "We believe investors are intrigued but still wary regarding wireless services pricing."
